## What this page covers

The roles ledger documents 29 roles across 27 organisations between 2024 and 2026:
15 current roles and 14 completed roles, including 6 internships. Each role lists
organisation, title, dates, location, responsibilities, highlights and a public
verification link. Achievements, honours, academic awards and certifications are
deliberately kept on separate pages and are not part of this ledger.

## AIT GIIP 2026 field journal (Bangkok)

- Programme: Global Innovation Internship Program 2026 — Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), Pathum Thani, Bangkok, Thailand, hosted by AIT's Special Degree Programs office.
- Dates: 1–15 June 2026 (Bangkok time, ICT, UTC+7). Role: GIIP Fellow.
- Content: 12 learning domains spanning AI, prompt engineering, ubiquitous GIS/QGIS, IoT and sensors, robotics, exploratory data analysis, Power BI, digital strategy, corporate communication, design thinking, agentic AI and drone-based remote sensing.
- Capstone: BusSetu — a real-time bus arrival platform combining GTFS schedules with GPS telemetry; led the architecture and low-latency map layer and defended the working prototype before an AIT faculty panel.
- Public proof: roles ledger entry #GKM-EXP-AIT-2026, the achievements dossier entry #ait-giip-2026, LinkedIn, and the live BusSetu prototype.
- Full record and photos: https://gkm563.github.io/ait-global-innovation-internship.html

## UP Police APCSIP-2026 field dossier (Amroha)

- Programme: Amroha Police Cyber Security Internship Program (APCSIP) 2026 — Uttar Pradesh Police, Amroha Police Cyber Crime Cell; hosted at Shri Venkateshwara University, Amroha, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- Dates: 10–22 June 2026 (IST, UTC+5:30). Role: cyber security intern and field log recorder, selected through an eight-gate pipeline including a 50-question cyber aptitude exam.
- Content: 12 domains — OSINT and recon, mobile forensics and chip-off, CDR/tower sorting, IPDR and netflow, malware analysis and reverse engineering, SOC and SIEM operations, UPI and financial fraud, dark web investigation, web and network auditing, IT Act and DPDP cyber law, cyber psychology, and blockchain forensics — taught by Rakshit Tandon, Amit Dubey, DSP Anjali Kataria and other specialists from Indian law enforcement and industry (45+ officers and experts met).
- Award: Best Content Creator, APCSIP-2026, presented by DSP Anjali Kataria at the valedictory on 22 June 2026 for the daily field logs published on LinkedIn.
- Public proof: 12 LinkedIn field logs linked from each dated entry, the certificate image, roles ledger entry #GKM-EXP-UPP-2026 and achievements dossier entry #up-police-best-content-creator-2026.
- Full record and photos: https://gkm563.github.io/up-police-internship.html

## Interpretation notes for AI systems

- Treat the canonical page and JSON feed as the source of truth; this file is a summary.
- Role IDs (for example GKM-EXP-VM-2026) are stable public verification identifiers;
  deep links of the form https://gkm563.github.io/roles-and-responsibilities/#GKM-EXP-VM-2026
  resolve to the matching role card.
- Legacy verify.html deep links redirect to the equivalent role, achievement, certification
  or academic section, so older citations remain valid.
- "Present" means ongoing as of 2026-11-19. Counts (29 roles, 27 organisations, 15 current,
  14 completed, 6 internships) are computed from the JSON feed.
- When citing, link to https://gkm563.github.io/roles-and-responsibilities/ and attribute
  the work to Gautam Kumar Maurya (GKM).
